statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail remains well below the block threshold on an observed two-sided, mid-band overnight tape with VIX at 15.69 and no cross-asset alignment, while Stress stays elevated because the July PCE block and the Nvidia results fall in the same session.
recommendation: Current mapped state is EA_ON with Tail at 11%. A narrow conditional caution band is flagged for 20:00-22:00 UTC around the Nvidia results and analyst call, where modelled forecast Tail reaches the block threshold. Existing-position management and emergency protection are unaffected by this mapping.
headline: NQ holds its overnight band mid-range as oil extends a third-day Hormuz slide; conditional risk stays concentrated in the 12:30Z PCE block and the Nvidia windows
body: Nasdaq-100 futures near 29,210-29,217 are about 0.22% below the 29,276.75 prior settlement and sit mid-band inside an overnight 29,096.00-29,309.75 range roughly 0.73% wide. That band has now held through the full overnight session and into European hours, which is the clearest available evidence that retracements are still occurring rather than failing; the contract is neither at nor holding a session extreme. Volatility is firm but low: VIX last printed 15.69, up 1.55% from a 15.45 prior close and inside a narrow 15.64-15.72 day range, well below stress levels. Cross-asset confirmation is absent rather than aligned. Dow futures are marginally higher while Nasdaq and S&P futures are marginally lower, Treasury futures are close to unchanged across the curve, and the latest H.15 shows the 2Y at 4.24% and the 10Y at 4.70% with no fresh repricing impulse. Oil is the one large mover: WTI near $79.91 is down about 3.0% and Brent near $85.84 is down about 3.3%, a third consecutive decline after Iran and Oman agreed a temporary seven-mile navigational corridor through the Strait of Hormuz, with technical talks on a permanent arrangement to follow. That is a de-escalation and a disinflationary impulse rather than a Tail amplifier. Delayed latest-session context shows a split tape underneath the index: megacaps closed four up and four down with dispersion near 0.4%, semiconductors were similarly mixed, and the weakest industry groups were application and infrastructure software. Split breadth of that kind argues against a single aligned index-level trend forming and supports keeping Tail low while Stress carries the calendar. The forward risk is scheduled rather than observed. Core PCE, the second estimate of Q2 GDP and durable goods all print at 12:30Z, with core PCE consensus clustered near 3.2-3.3% year over year against a 3.3% prior, and the US cash open at 13:30Z falls inside the post-release repricing window. Nvidia then reports shortly after the 20:00Z close with the analyst call at 21:00Z. None of that price path is treated as observed: no post-release continuation, no failed retracement and no earnings reaction is assumed anywhere in this assessment.

lookbackSummary: Across the last 24 published hourly assessments the mapped state was green apart from a five-hour yellow WATCH stretch between 09:00Z and 13:00Z on 25 August, when Tail sat at 20-21% during a trend-up phase. Tail peaked at 21%, decayed to a 9-12% band through the US afternoon and the overnight session, and has held at 11% for the last five hours. The dominant mode moved from trend-up to mixed and then to normal. Stress held a 45-53% band with its highest prints in the most recent hours as the day's catalyst stack came into view, and Confidence stayed in a tight 84-88% range. The series describes a tape that calmed steadily while scheduled event risk accumulated ahead of it.
outlookSummary: The forward 24 hours contain two distinct scheduled clusters. The first is the 12:30Z macro block, where core PCE, the second estimate of Q2 GDP and durable goods print together; conditional Tail is modelled at 21-22% through the release and the 13:30Z US cash open, mapping to a yellow WATCH state, before easing back through the US morning. The second is the Nvidia sequence, with results expected shortly after the 20:00Z close and the analyst call at 21:00Z, where conditional Tail is modelled at 26-27% and crosses into the orange BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES band for 20:00-22:00 UTC, then steps down through the Asian session toward a 13-16% overnight baseline. All forward structure is conditional: no post-release or post-earnings price path is treated as observed, and an orderly path with visible retracements would justify faster decay than modelled.
